evidence.claim: The second-generation model scored flagged transaction 3528764 at 0.992, which corresponds to a calibrated historical fraud rate of 0.921 (92.1%).
Flagged transaction 3528764 was executed online using a device marked New for the account (device D000072) operating behind an anonymous proxy (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS).

Just 4 minutes and 42 seconds before online transaction 3528764 at 21:38:25, in-person transaction 3528739 occurred at 21:33:43 in billing region 494, indicating concurrent card-not-present use while the physical cardholder was active in person elsewhere.
Card C10835-K2 belongs to Louvain community 128974894, which has a 100% fraud rate across 2 member cards (lift of 9.9 vs base rate), alongside card C12598-K2 which has multiple confirmed fraud cases.
Card C10835-K2 was previously compromised in confirmed fraud case CC-2130 in August 2016 ($210.04, out-of-region use), resulting in the card being blocked and reissued.
Transaction 3528764 was associated with billing region 184, which matches the primary region for card C10835-K2 (82 of 128 prior transactions, 64.1%).
Card C10835-K2 has prior history in product category R (11 prior transactions) and online transactions (32 prior transactions).

case.summary: An alert was investigated for online transaction 3528764 ($350.04) on card C10835-K2 after the second-generation fraud model assigned a score of 0.992, reflecting a 92.1% historical fraud rate. The transaction was executed via an anonymous proxy on a device marked new to the account (device D000072). Crucially, an in-person transaction occurred in region 494 fewer than five minutes prior, confirming concurrent unauthorized card-not-present activity. Although the transaction matched the cardholder's primary billing region, the timing conflict and anonymous proxy corroborate compromise. The activity was confirmed as card-not-present fraud from a new device, resulting in a card block and case creation.

stop_reason: The investigation concluded pursuant to policy section 6 as the fraud probability reached 0.943 (exceeding the decisive 0.85 threshold) supported by multiple independent evidence bases, including the calibrated model score, anonymous proxy routing on a new device, and physically impossible timing relative to a concurrent card-present transaction.
